data.name: Hike & Climb
data.headline: All Ages! • 8 Hours • Up to 7 people!
data.description:
#Our private, single-day hiking and climbing tours with a certified guide are the perfect way to immerse yourself in all that Joshua Tree National Park has to offer.		
												

##Duration 
8 hours

##About
After meeting at our office, Your guide will then take you on a drive through the most incredible parts of the park. Along the way, you will receive a detailed narration on the park, its history, and interesting geology unique to Joshua Tree. Once at your trailhead, your guide will lead you on a mostly off-trail adventure through the Joshua Tree wilderness. Towering rock formations, canyons, sweeping vistas, and surreal landscapes from another planet await you around every bend. Enjoy an optional lunch on the trail before meeting your rock guides to climb and rappel from our world-famous rock formations. Your climbing experience includes professional instruction from our certified rock guide, and all necessary equipment. Whether you are a first-time climber or multi-pitch expert, our guides will make sure you have an incredible experience.  All throughout the day, your personal guides will share the history and geology of the Park, along with a myriad of stories and talks about the plants, animals, and other unique characteristics of the Park. You may even get to add in some epic rock scrambling to the top of some of our otherworldly rock formations, for views and experiences rarely had by others. At the conclusion of your hike and climb, time permitting, your guide will try to get you to some of the other popular sights in the park before returning you safely to our office where you can relax and talk about the memories that you have made, that will last a lifetime. NOTE: Due to the extended time period for this journey, pick-up and drop-off is not available. All hike and climb trips will meet at our office in Joshua Tree.												
														

##More Info
INCLUDES: Guided tour, hiking, climbing, all equipment, private instruction Park fees, Transportation from our office, and Water. Optional meals available for purchase.
15-20% gratuity is customary.

##In the event you need to cancel your trip, the following cancellation policies will apply: 

- Cancellations  for all trips tours and activities made 31+ days prior to departure  date – All fees paid to date will be refunded, less any pre-paid trip expenses (special events, sound bath, permits etc.) 

- Cancellation for any single or multi-day activities made between 30 and 0 days of scheduled departure date –  All fees, deposits and payments become non-refundable regardless of circumstances. All fees are fully transferrable to any future trip or tour.

- Cancellation of  Camping, Backpacking, or other multi-day or large group event/ trip within 30 days of trip results in forfeiture of all fees paid. Payments are transferrable to future trips.

- A  cancellation will be effective when Joshua Tree Excursions receives  written notification of the cancellation. This cancellation policy  includes voluntary or involuntary early departure from a trip. No refunds will be given for missed or unused services such as  accommodation, activities or meals. You are strongly advised to take out  cancellation insurance that will cover cancellation fees at the time of  booking.


##LATE ARRIVAL
 Unless previously coordinated, any guest or group that is 30 minutes or more late for their scheduled tour,  without notification, will be deemed to have cancelled, abandoned, or  forfeited their trip and no refunds will be given.

##NO SHOWS
-  If any member of your group or party is unable to participate, for any  reason, no refunds will be provided unless notification of no show is  provided within 7 days of departure. Refund will be less any irrecoverable fees.

- Guests canceling will have the option of  applying or transferring any non-refunded fees to future tours or trips;  as long as any such trip is re-booked,  within 90  days of cancelled trip, regardless of actual departure date..

- A party will not be in breach of or in  default under this agreement on account of, and will not be liable to  the other party for, any delay or failure to perform [his][her][its]  obligations under this agreement by reason of fire, earthquake, flood,  explosion, strike, riot, war, terrorism, park closure or similar event  beyond that party’s reasonable control (each a “Force Majeure Event”). However, if a Force Majeure Event occurs, the affected party shall, as soon as practicable:

- Notify  the other party of the Force Majeure Event and its impact on  performance under this agreement; and                                              

- Use reasonable efforts to resolve any issues resulting  from the Force Majeure Event and perform [his][her][its] obligations  under this agreement.

- Note: Joshua Tree Excursions reserves the right to refund all, a portion of, or none of, the fees paid for trips  or tours, based on the circumstances at the time of cancellation.

#CANCELLATION  BY JOSHUA TREE EXCURSIONS
We occasionally may have to cancel a  scheduled trip at any time, up to and including day of departure, due to  unforeseen circumstances: ( weather, hazardous conditions, park  closures or other limiting factors related to safety ).  If Joshua Tree  Excursions cancels your trip for any reason outside of Force Majure ,  you can transfer any fees paid to an alternate departure date for no additional fee ( based on availability ) or alternatively opt for a full  refund. In circumstances where the cancellation is due to events  outside our control, such as natural disasters, terrorism or political  instability, and we are unable to operate the trip as planned; refunds  will be less any unrecoverable costs. Joshua Tree Excursions is not  responsible for any incidental expenses that you may have incurred as a  result of your booking, including but not limited to lodging, travel  insurance excess, or non-refundable flights.
